status: design catalog; implementation status is recorded in tools/curios_manifest.json

ranks.role: bounded secondary loop and commission control

warrior.visibility: Show guard, threat target and the next valid Bough charge trigger.
warrior.handshake: A successful block marks one attacker; the next Warrior threat skill consumes the mark instead of creating a second damage proc.
warrior.mastery: Tectonic Girdle and Greatbole Torque share knockback-state feedback; resisted movement can arm utility, never bonus damage.
warrior.guardrail: No passive damage reduction, extra heart package or Odin-ring effect is copied onto the suite.

hunter.visibility: Show ammunition source, owned trap state, wolf state and recoverable projectile locations.
hunter.handshake: Quiver-supplied shots and recovered arrows use one routing path; the suite never creates replacement ammunition.
hunter.mastery: A successful native dodge can prime one trap-control utility window; damage remains on the soul and skill.
hunter.guardrail: No arrow duplication, permanent invisibility, free projectile reach or trap cooldown reset.

sorcerer.visibility: Display Mine and Slash mana, Ars Source access and Iron spell mana as separate meters with their actual owner.
sorcerer.handshake: Prism attunement narrows class-signet affixes toward fire, cold or confluence without converting one mod resource into another.
sorcerer.mastery: Alternating valid Fire and Cold Mine and Slash skills may arm a Confluence utility window; raw spell power stays in normal affix budget.
sorcerer.guardrail: No Source↔mana conversion, duplicate cooldown reduction or cross-mod spell-power multiplication.

shaman.visibility: Show owned totems, their remaining time, restoration targets and local Aura condition when an ocular is present.
shaman.handshake: Aura storage and summoning tools provide state/context for Rootspeaker actions; totems never generate free Aura or Source.
shaman.mastery: Completing restoration and storm actions around the same active totem arms a bounded renewal utility window.
shaman.guardrail: No passive Aura generation, immortal summons, autonomous healing loop or second copy of native totem restoration.

warlock.visibility: Show curse ownership, summon timers and whether a timeout or kill caused removal.
warlock.handshake: Valid cursed or summoned encounters write bounded memory marks used by explicit Occultism cross-binding recipes.
warlock.mastery: Conjurer talismans expose timeout state to the emblem; their cooldown exception is never duplicated by the class suite.
warlock.guardrail: No free summon cooldown skip, extra ricochet, invisibility inheritance or loot from repeatedly resummoning.

minstrel.visibility: Show song radius, eligible party members, active song families and overheal separately.
minstrel.handshake: Different valid song families build resonance; repeating one song refreshes state but does not farm additional stacks.
minstrel.mastery: Nearby crafters can receive an Inspired Work cue and commission attribution, never profession XP or free outputs.
minstrel.guardrail: No aura-ring mana duplication, permanent charm control, free healing echo or multiplicative party stacking.

mining.title: Bloom Delver
mining.action: player breaks a naturally generated, tier-mapped ore/bloom with a valid mining tool
mining.visibility: Show ore/bloom profession tier, expected depth band, tool validity and whether the block awards native XP.
mining.handshake: Ring of the Mantle supplies Haste; goggles/ocular data and native drops remain separate. Route mining materials to an equipped bag without duplicating them.
mining.mastery: Unlock survey commissions and tier-appropriate bloom targeting that consumes an explicit mana/aura reagent.
mining.guardrail: Placed blocks, Silk Touch replacement loops and automated breakers award no player proof or XP.

farming.title: Grove Tender
farming.action: player harvests a mature mapped crop; growth-stage requirement must pass
farming.visibility: Show maturity, mapped profession tier, local Aura condition and missing crop integration.
farming.handshake: Agricarnation, Agronomic Sourcelink and Ritual of Growth may grow crops, but only the actual player harvest can award personal profession proof.
farming.mastery: Crop-family diversity unlocks seed and reagent commissions; it does not raise harvest yield.
farming.guardrail: No break/replant loop on immature crops, automated XP, passive growth pulse or duplicate produce.

fishing.title: Tidekeeper
fishing.action: player completes a valid fishing catch through the native hook
fishing.visibility: Record water/biome condition, catch family, native material tier and cooking demand.
fishing.handshake: Ring of Chordata improves underwater work while the cuff routes caught ingredients to the Hearthkeeper chain.
fishing.mastery: Catch-family diversity produces a commission ledger used in native Cooking recipes; it never rolls a second catch.
fishing.guardrail: No AFK catch multiplier, extra treasure roll, weather bypass or duplicate fishing material.

husbandry.title: Wildward
husbandry.action: player completes a valid animal breeding event for a mapped adult pair
husbandry.visibility: Show valid feed, breeding cooldown, species mapping and lineage diversity.
husbandry.handshake: Diva/familiar/summoning tools assist handling and pickup; they do not count as player breeding or generate animals.
husbandry.mastery: Species-diverse husbandry commissions unlock hide, fibre and cooking routes using native meat materials.
husbandry.guardrail: No slaughter XP, child rebreeding, dispenser credit, summoned-creature breeding or repeated pair spam.

salvaging.title: Memory Reclaimer
salvaging.action: player confirms a genuine soul-bearing item at the native salvage station
salvaging.visibility: Show salvage eligibility, protected/favorited state and a preview category without revealing hidden random results.
salvaging.handshake: Magnets and familiars collect drops; bags/satchels form a marked queue, but the native salvage station remains mandatory.
salvaging.mastery: Batch confirmation and commission attribution reduce clicks while preserving every input and output roll.
salvaging.guardrail: Never salvage equipped/favorited items, auto-salvage pickups, reroll results or create rarity escalation loops.

gear_crafting.title: Armsinger
gear_crafting.action: player completes a native Gear Crafting recipe at its station
gear_crafting.visibility: Show frame era, profession tier, missing prepared step, soul outcome range and station validity.
gear_crafting.handshake: Create stress, Mana routing and otherworld materials appear in one read-only work order; each mod keeps its own power system.
gear_crafting.mastery: Signed commissions and class-crystal recipes narrow a legal soul profile while retaining native level/rarity rules.
gear_crafting.guardrail: No material discount, free rarity, NBT-destructive frame upgrade or crafting-table bypass.

enchanting.title: Runeweaver
enchanting.action: player completes a native Infusing/Enchanting recipe at its station
enchanting.visibility: Show compatible affix family, socket/rune state, resource owner and destructive choices before confirmation.
enchanting.handshake: Ars discounts, Iron affinity and Botania mana keep their native scopes; crystals only select explicit Mine and Slash recipe branches.
enchanting.mastery: A costly master recipe may protect one chosen affix family during a reroll while consuming the normal orb plus an added reagent.
enchanting.guardrail: No free reroll, cross-mod mana discount, copied enchantment, guaranteed maximum affix or hidden NBT loss.

cooking.title: Hearthkeeper
cooking.action: player completes a native Cooking recipe or an explicitly mapped Farmer/Miners Delight preparation
cooking.visibility: Show meal family, MMO food category, active-food conflict and missing side ingredients.
cooking.handshake: Mapped Farmer/Miners Delight dishes become explicit inputs to native Cooking recipes instead of silently granting profession XP.
cooking.mastery: Party platters divide the same total portions into a commission output; they do not multiply servings or stack duplicate food buffs.
cooking.guardrail: No XP for ordinary crafting unless mapped, no passive feeding, no meal duplication and strongest-only overlapping MMO food rule.

alchemy.title: Dewbrewer
alchemy.action: player completes a native Alchemy recipe or an explicitly mapped botanical/Ars preparation
alchemy.visibility: Show effect family, potency/duration branch, active conflict and whether a container preserves NBT.
alchemy.handshake: Botanical brews, Ars flasks and Mine and Slash potions meet through explicit conversion recipes with separate resource costs.
alchemy.mastery: Choose duration or potency at equal budget, or bind an eligible brew into a pendant through a validated NBT-preserving operation.
alchemy.guardrail: No instant-consumption duplication, permanent buff copy, free container, effect stacking exploit or generic potion XP.
